lineNotes: One OSM route relation per line (one direction; the other runs on the same track or beside it). Numbers are the public line numbers on the Rapid KL / KTM / ERL network map (also in the relations' ref tags for KTM, ERL and MRT). The Shah Alam Line (11) and the suspended Skypark Link (10) do not enter the box.
mergeNotes: Stops of different lines whose names agree once the bracketed line hints are dropped ("KL Sentral (KJ)", "KL Sentral (KTM)") and that lie within mergeM metres are one interchange station.

transfers.note: Muzium Negara MRT – KL Sentral, linked by a covered walkway (paid-to-paid link not assumed)
Dang Wangi LRT – Bukit Nanas Monorail, linked by a pedestrian walkway
Plaza Rakyat LRT – Merdeka MRT, linked by a pedestrian walkway
Mid Valley KTM – Abdullah Hukum LRT, the walk through KL Eco City (map-assets klec-midvalley route)

transferNotes: Walking changes between stations with different names. The walking distance is the straight line between the stations, so it is a lower bound.
